title: Easy 5-Ingredient Cacio e Pepe
description: The creamiest cacio e pepe you'll ever make! Just pasta, pecorino, black pepper, pasta water, and a pinch of salt. Mix the cheese with pasta water first, then toss with hot pasta. The key is the emulsion! Serves 2. Ready in 15 minutes.

title: Authentic Italian Carbonara
description: Real carbonara with guanciale, pecorino, eggs, and black pepper. No cream! Cook guanciale until crispy, mix eggs with cheese, toss with hot pasta off heat. The residual heat cooks the eggs perfectly. Serves 4. Takes 20 minutes.

title: Korean Fried Chicken (KFC) - Super Crispy!
description: Double-fried Korean chicken that's insanely crispy! Marinate chicken in ginger, garlic, soy sauce for 30 minutes. Coat in cornstarch, fry at 350°F for 8 minutes, rest 5 minutes, fry again at 375°F for 5 minutes. Toss in gochujang glaze. Serves 3-4.

title: 10-Minute Kimchi Fried Rice
description: Quick and delicious kimchi fried rice! Use day-old rice, kimchi, gochujang, sesame oil, and top with a fried egg. Fry kimchi first for 2 minutes, add rice and gochujang, stir-fry for 5 minutes. Top with egg and sesame seeds. Serves 2. Perfect weeknight dinner!

title: Best Carne Asada Tacos
description: Restaurant-quality carne asada tacos at home! Marinate flank steak in lime juice, garlic, cilantro, cumin for 2 hours. Grill on high heat for 3-4 minutes per side. Slice thin, serve in tortillas with onions, cilantro, and lime. Serves 4. Grilling time: 8 minutes.

title: 30-Minute Butter Chicken
description: Creamy butter chicken that tastes like it took hours! Marinate chicken in yogurt and spices for 15 minutes. Cook in butter with onions, garlic, ginger for 5 minutes. Add tomatoes, cream, garam masala. Simmer 20 minutes. Serve with rice or naan. Serves 4.

title: Perfect Sushi Rice Every Time
description: Master sushi rice with this simple method! Rinse rice 3 times, cook with 1:1.1 water ratio. Mix rice vinegar, sugar, salt while rice is hot. Fold gently to coat evenly. Let cool to room temperature. Makes enough for 4 rolls. Prep time: 30 minutes.
